title: On Intersections of System Normalizers
summary: We give a negative answer to Problem 17.39 of the Kourovka Notebook. For every odd prime power $q$ and every $m\geq1$, we construct a finite metabelian group $G_{m,q}$ with $Z_\infty(G_{m,q})=1$ and $|Φ(G_{m,q})|=q$ for which the least number of system normalizers with trivial intersection is $m+1$. Thus the number is unbounded even when the order of the Frattini subgroup is fixed.
